findings.title: Solidity < 0.8 (no built-in overflow checks)
findings.description: Pre-0.8 Solidity wraps silently on overflow unless SafeMath is used consistently.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade to >=0.8.20 or verify SafeMath is applied to every arithmetic operation.

triage.reason: The total supply of ETH is bounded far below 2^256 - 1 wei (total supply is ~1.2e26 wei vs uint256 max of ~1.15e77 wei), making integer overflow in deposit() and transferFrom() mathematically impossible in practice.

limitations: Report AI stage produced by Google Gemini (provider: gemini, model: gemini-3.5-flash).
Exploit scenarios are reasoned from the code, not executed.
NightWatch is automated analysis, not a formal audit. Absence of findings is not a guarantee of safety.
